title: emily-scribbles-micro-plan-2026-03-19
content:
Morning brain dump - quick, messy. Not for anyone else.

Today top 3 (MITs)
- finish review of PR #587 (perf regression on KV cache warmup) — block: need run of staging with longer prefix samples
- ship small staging deploy with new batching knob (saves ~7% tokens in initial test)
- write blurb for weekly sync: "what we tried w/ caching" (2 slides max)

Small errands (personal)
- drop off dry cleaning by 5pm (remember coupon in wallet)
- mail passport copy to travel agency (scan -> attach)
- buy milk + bananas (only if not too heavy)

Meeting notes / snippets
- 1:1 w/ Sam @10: ask about oncall rotation swap (week of 4/6) and headcount ask for infra hire
- Sync w/ SRE @11: confirm rollback window for dedicated capacity test, default 10m -> maybe 15m if warmup needed
- Quick with PD team: they want a brief on Private deploy footprint for EU customers (poke product-ops)

Deploy checklist (staging) - lightweight
- bump image tag (emily/cache-batch-20260319)
- run smoke: basic endpoints + /health + small chat convo (30 tokens)
- monitor: latency 50p, 95p, failure rate (<0.5%) for first 10m
- if token-per-request cost spikes >10% rollback immediately

Notes to self: KV/cache experiment ideas
- try prefix-sampling set: [8, 16, 32] tokens to simulate different convo lengths; look for tail latencies
- measure cold-start vs steady-state throughput separately (warmup = first 2 requests?)
- consider adding ephemeral local cache on worker if net hit rate > 0.6

Random thoughts / followups
- draft note to legal about storing customer prompts during Private trials (what retention do they expect?) -> attach ticket ENG-3421
- follow up with UX on streaming indicator (users confused when first token delayed)
- simple A/B idea: always send cached-prefix-hint header from client to help routing (worth prototyping)

Micro errands at desk
- plug phone in (battery ~20%)
- refill water bottle
- print boarding pass? maybe later

Evening wrap (TODO for EOD)
- merge small doc for weekly sync
- push one more perf test with 500-sample batch (longer run) and leave overnight
- email Jared quick summary of deploy plan

Unresolved / questions
- how noisy is the current metric for "cache hit" across models? need clearer definition (prefix vs exact token-level)
- who owns the billing alert for dedicated burst? ops or billing? tag ops-owner in ticket

Tiny personal log (to remember mood)
- feeling scattered but oddly productive. coffee x2.

End of scribbles.

(If I come back: convert the notes above into a proper PR checklist + a 1-slide summary for the sync)
